# Three.js 0.160.0

Unmodified ES module downloaded from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js
on 25 October 2026. Local hosting avoids a runtime CDN request or CSP change.

- `three.module.js`: 1,272,972 bytes, SHA-256 `76dea8151bc9352aef3528b4262e249b2604f62543828328db978d060d61a495`.
- `LICENSE`: MIT, copyright 2010–2023 three.js authors; SHA-256 `852e0e8699169bf9f6fdc6bda3e682d078dcbc738b5d33e74df594721bff271d`.

The museum already uses release 0.160.0. The optional Atlas loads this local module
only on 3D activation (including a 3D share URL). No additional runtime library,
telemetry, font, physics engine or CDN is added. The unminified distribution is
compatible with the repository's bounded asset-reference parser; the upstream
minified distribution was not, and is not included. Do not alter this vendor file
merely to quiet that parser. A version change needs source and license validation.
